newsitem.title: UK: Russian seaborne crude exports fall in Sep - ports.
newsitem.headline: Russian seaborne crude exports fall in Sep - ports.

text.p: Russian seaborne crude exports fell slightly in September as an increase in shipments from Novorossiisk was more than countered by lower volumes from other ports, port officials said on Wednesday.

Crude exports from the Russian ports of Novorossiisk and Tuapse, the Ukrainian port of Odessa and the Latvian port of Ventspils totalled 1.249 million barrels per day (bpd) in September, 7,000 bpd down on August.
But the main Black Sea port of Novorossiisk shipped 702,747 bpd in September, an increase of more than 73,000 bpd on the previous month.
Exports from Odessa fell nearly 21,000 bpd to 182,013 bpd, while shipments from Tuapse were down more than 32,000 bpd on August at 61,806 bpd.
September shipments from the Baltic port of Ventspils fell by over 23,000 bpd to 302,707 bpd, a port spokesman said.
